title: Racing vs. Boca Juniors: Copa Argentina Derby
seoTitle: Racing vs Boca Juniors: Copa Argentina Derby
subtitle: The clash that could decide a tournament semifinalist
excerpt: The Copa Argentina 2026 quarterfinal clash between Racing and Boca Juniors is in the spotlight after Racing beat Belgrano and Boca edged Vélez on penalties.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The derby between Racing and Boca Juniors in the quarterfinals of the Copa Argentina 2026 is in the spotlight after Racing defeated Belgrano and Boca edged Vélez in a penalty shootout. The match, set for September 27 at 5:00 p.m., promises tension and intense rivalry.

Quarterfinals to decide a semifinalist

The showdown takes place this Sunday (27) at 5:00 p.m. (Brasília time) at Estadio Presidente Juan Domingo Perón in Avellaneda. The fixture will decide who moves on to the semifinals of the Copa Argentina 2026.

Racing looking to bounce back

Racing are coming off an important 1-0 victory over Belgrano de Córdoba and maintain an impeccable campaign in the competition, having won all three of their Copa Argentina matches. At home, the team has a 100% success rate, with six goals scored and only one conceded. However, their form in the Argentine league is a different story, with six losses in their last ten games. The team could showcase either its Copa Argentina version or the vulnerable Clausura squad.

Boca Juniors in strong form

Boca Juniors head into the derby with an impressive run in the Copa Argentina, winning both matches so far while scoring four goals and conceding none. The team is also experiencing a great overall spell, carrying a long unbeaten run across all competitions and having already secured qualification for the next stage of the Copa Sudamericana.

Probable lineups

Racing probable lineup: Facundo Cambeses; Mateo Martínez, Marcos Rojo, Gonzalo Escudero; Matías Zaracho, Ulises Ortegoza, Leonel Pérez, Gastón Lodico, Ignacio Rodríguez; Duván Vergara (Adrián Fernández), Adrián Martínez. Head coach: Juan Pablo Vojvoda.

Boca Juniors probable lineup: Leandro Brey; Leandro Lozano, Lautaro Di Lollo, Facundo Herrera, Lautaro Blanco; Leandro Paredes, Milton Delgado, Santiago Ascacíbar; Alan Velasco, Leonel Flores, Miguel Merentiel. Head coach: Rodolfo Arruabarrena.

Where to watch and kickoff time

The match will be broadcast live on Xsports and can be tracked in real time on betting platforms such as 365Scores. The official kickoff is at 5:00 p.m. (Brasília time).

Key statistics

  • Racing have 13 wins, 10 draws, and 14 defeats on the season.
  • Boca Juniors have 20 wins, 14 defeats, and just 8 defeats on the season.
  • In the current Copa Argentina, Racing have scored 6 goals and conceded just 1 in 3 matches.
  • Boca Juniors have found the back of the net 4 times and have yet to concede a goal in 2 tournament games.

Expert prediction

The website SportyTrader predicts under 2.5 goals for the match, taking into account the intensity of the derby and recent history between the sides.

Final summary

The Racing vs. Boca Juniors derby in the quarterfinals of the Copa Argentina 2026 promises to be a tense encounter, with Racing seeking recovery and Boca Juniors sustaining strong form. The match, set for September 27 at 5:00 p.m., will be broadcast on Xsports and can be tracked in real time via 365Scores. The outcome will decide who advances to the tournament semifinals.

With reporting from Gazeta Esportiva, 365Scores, SportyTrader.
